name: Cleanroom Technician
description: Foundry Floor cleanroom technician in a white bunny suit: hood with blue trim, smoked goggles and graphite-edged face mask, blue gloves and boot covers. Six rigid parts (torso, head, armLeft, armRight, legLeft, legRight), 4 materials, 4,688 triangles, Walk/Idle/Service clips. Stands 1.75 m on Y=0, facing +X.
brief: Foundry Floor utility kit (interior batch 3), asset 3 of 3: cleanroom-technician. Generic chip-fab worker, no text or logos. Size X0.35 x Y1.75 x Z0.55, 2,500-5,000 tris, root between the feet, facing +X, feet on Y=0. Parts: torso, head (rotates about Y at the neck), armLeft/armRight (about Z at the shoulder), legLeft/legRight (about Z at the hip). Materials: suit-white, suit-blue, glass-smoked, trim-graphite. Clips: Walk 1.1 s (loop), Idle 4 s (loop), Service 3 s (loop).
